01About Owl

# WebuiltOwlforthepersonontheotherendofthefile.

Every year, tens of millions of people file an insurance claim on the worst day of their year, and then they wait. Behind every claim is a file of 800 to 2,400 pages no single examiner can read in full. Owl is the company that decided that wait is the problem worth solving.

01Our mission

## WeStrivetoProvideKnowledge

With every claim, insurers have the possibility to make a positive difference in someone’s life.We aim to liberate claims teams with intelligence so they can do their best work helping claimants and you can build a human-first future for insurance.

02Our Philosophy

## WeCareAboutTruth

With clarity and knowledge, insurers have the confidence they need to make impactful claims decisions.We believe insurance should be powered by truth, not guesswork. Our AI enables accountability and fairness so insurers have the right data at the right time to act decisively.

03The technology

## FourAIsolutions,togiveclaimantsthecaretheydeserve.

Each agent solves one piece of the wait, so the human paid to decide can spend their time on the part of the job that needs a human: the rare hard case, the claimant on the phone, the judgment call.

04Our commitments

## Sixpromiseswemaketothepersonontheotherendofthefile.

These are not aspirations. Each one gates a release, sits in a contract, or both.

01AI never denies a claim.–

Owl never makes the adverse decision. Adverse determinations require a licensed human reviewer and a written rationale. Our software surfaces the evidence, supports the decision and audits the outcome. It does not issue the denial. This is a product principle, contractually enforced and externally audited.

02Every output is sourced.+

03We measure what claimants feel.+

04Disparate-impact audited before release.+

05Claimant data is never training data.+

06We will say no.+

05A letter we keep on the wall

> “The day my husband's appeal was approved, my son had been in the hospital for eleven months. I had stopped opening mail from the insurance company. When the letter came I could not read it for three days. When I finally did, I cried for an hour. Not because of the money. Because someone, somewhere, had finally read the file.
> ”

BC

B.M., Charlotte, NC. Group LTD claimreopened on appeal in March 2025 after Owl flagged seven contradicted exam notes the prior reviewer had not surfaced. Shared with permission.
